This Sportsman Masters 247 Center Console is absolutely rigged to the max! It is powered by a Mercury 350 HP V10 delivering incredible performance and the most luxurious handling available. This boat has just about everything including the Half Tower with 2nd Station, Garmin Force Kraken Trolling Motor, Two 12\" Garmin Screens and a 3rd Garmin screen up in the Half Tower, JL Audio Stereo System Upgrade, Bow Cushion Set, Removable Bow Backrests, Premium Dual Chair Leaning Post, Cooler Slide out Track, Under Leaning Post Tackle Storage, 7 ProMariner Battery Charger. These boats come with some awesome Standard Features including the Sea Keeper RIDE Auto Trim Tab System. This system corrects the rocking back and forth while underway automatically. It also comes with the Hydraulic Jack Plate, Underwater Lighting, Glass Windshield, Total Access Hatch & Aquarium Style Live Wells.


The design team had lofty goals when tasked with reimagining the top-selling Masters 247. The redesign focused on opening up more cockpit space behind the leaning post, redesigning the console to accommodate d-tubing and incorporating a tempered glass windshield, along with other minor improvements. The results are a stunning bay boat that performs as well as it looks. This top-selling 24' bay boat is miles ahead of its time and ready for serious fishing. The deck features dual aquarium livewells, a large bow casting deck with lockable rod storage, plenty of comfortable seating for up to 10 people, best-in-class bilge access and much more. All of this is paired with a very capable hull designed for shallow water and a smooth ride. The Masters 247 now features the revolutionary Seakeeper Ride System in a first-of-its-kind built-in pocket design. This system uses actuators and stabilization technology to improve the ride quality in any condition, providing a smoother and more comfortable ride for all onboard. The Seakeeper Ride system is seamlessly integrated into the boat's transom design, making it virtually invisible. With this cutting-edge feature, the Masters 247 sets a new standard for bay boats and offers a level of comfort and stability that was previously unheard of in its class.

This awesome 2017 Formula 430SSC with only 400 hours is priced to sell. The boat is powered by quad Mercury Racing 400 HP Verados. The boat is in nice condition and loaded with great options and features including, Generator, Air Conditioning, Twin Raymarine Axiom Pro 12S GPS widescreen color chart plotters, Hot Water Heater, and a massive hard Top. The cabin is huge and has a Mid berth so it can sleep 4 people. The layout of this boat is incredible and feels very open. There is plenty of seating and lounging space all over the boat. This boat is perfect for doing long trips on or just taking out for the day. It is very easy to maintain and operate. The design of the 43-foot crossover sport boat is based on the SmartZone concept, which means space is fully optimized aboard the 430 Super Sport Crossover. Triple command seating is located in the sport crossover boat’s side console helm. This flexible seating enables you to retain full command of your performance-oriented boat regardless of whether you’re sitting, standing or resting on the seat in an upright position. When you’re behind your boat’s leather-wrapped, tilt-steering stainless steering wheel, you’ll overlook a dash that consists of liquid black panels that show off eye-catching metallic accents. You’ll notice standard twin Raymarine Axiom Pro 12s GPS widescreen color chartplotters on the dash, which can be upgraded to dual or triple Axiom Pro 16s. A Mercury DTS with SmartCraft VesselView is also standard on the innovative 430 Super Sport Crossover. State-of-the-art technology is abundant at the helm, where you’ll find a Raymarine gS95 display and a wireless iPad control. If you activate your subscription to cellular remote control, you’ll enjoy the freedom that comes with being able to operate your crossover sport boat with a mobile device.You’ll have fun blasting your favorite tunes using the dash-mounted Rockford Fosgate stereo system that delivers music through ten JL Audio speakers and two 200W subwoofers. This premium sound system supports Bluetooth connectivity, and it has a convenient USB port to keep your devices charged.

Enter the Formula 430 Super Sport Crossover, a revolutionary concept that is destined to change the performance boating experience. Formula combines the confident command of our sleek Super Sport lineup with open bow and cabin elements that spring from our unparalleled Crossover Bowrider, then incorporates the nimble versatility of a flush cockpit center console outboard. The result is the paradigm-shifting 430 SSC – a transformative adventure where boaters truly can have the best of all worlds. Virtually every boater’s preference is satisfied in the 430 SSC cockpit, from up-front exhilaration in the expansive bow to the flexible coupe design with full-width motorized glass sunroof and triple command seating, to the U-shaped lounge aft with convertible rear-facing sunpad and extended swim platform. Add to that cabin accommodations which offer surprising amenities previously encountered only in closed bow vessels, including a convertible dinette/sleeping berth, aft stateroom with queen-size Sensus® memory foam bed, private stand-up head compartment, full galley and premium AV entertainment. The 430 deep-V hull with FAS3Tech® multi-step design and quad outboard power delivers the swift, stable Formula performance that is respected worldwide. Go offshore without compromise, in a vessel that so smartly balances purpose with pleasure, where every feature is on target for your needs.

"GeneralBoatDescription": [ "

This Robalo 317 Dual Console is a show stopper with it's Alloy Grey Hull Sides & Bottom! It is powered by twin Yamaha 300 HP 4-Strokes w/ Digital Throttle & Shift as well as Electric Power Steering. This Power Package also has the optional Yamaha Helm Master Joystick Piloting System w/ Full Maneuverability and Auto Pilot. If you are looking for a boat that can do it all but with an emphasis on Entertaining and Comfort then this is the perfect boat for you! The boat has many areas to layout and relax in the shade or in the sun. The Hard Top is very large and has a Retractable Rear Sun Shade (Sure Shade) that covers the whole rear Lounge / Seat. The Rear Seat has electric Backrests that allow it to convert from a dual sided bench seat to a large Lounge with capability to recline forwards, backwards, or lay all the way down. The boat also has a Very nice Live Bait Well and large Fish Box / Cooler. Other options include the Simrad 16\" GPS / Fish Finder, JL Audio Stereo Upgraded System, VHF Radio, Cockpit Gas Grill, Wetbar, Toilet w/ Overboard Discharge, Polish Stainless Anchor, Bow & Cockpit Cover, (2) Stainless Rod / Cup Holders, and 5 Year Premium Level Limited Component Warranty.

This is a super clean NauticStar 243 DC and it is powered by a 200 Yamaha 4-Stroke with only 286 hours on it! It has been kept with a Bow and Cockpit cover on it and in a high and Dry its whole life. One owner boat. This boat does have a Live well in it which makes it very versatile, great for cruising and gives the ability to go fishing as well. All the upholstery in the boat is in perfect condition. The gel coat all over the boat is in very nice condition. It is loaded with nice options including a Toilet w/ Overboard Discharge, Bimini Top, Bow & Cockpit Cover, Live well, Cooler, Ski Tow Bar, Snap in Flooring, Freshwater Shower, & Simrad Screen.

Combine size with performance and that’s what you get with the 243 DC. Check out the fully enclosed walk-in dressing room with optional portable toilet, wraparound seating in the cockpit and the pressurized water system that services the galley and optional transom shower. 24′ in length, your choice of outboard power, 100% wood free construction, comfortable durable “leather touch upholstery”, and NauticStar’s STAR Performance System are some of the features that make this a popular choice in the experienced boating crowd.

This beautiful 2025 Contender 30 ST Center Console is finally here! This is the new model with the completely flat swim platform (they got rid of the motor well). The boat is Ice Blue and is powered with twin Yamaha 300 HP 4-Strokes with the Digital Electric Steering making it a blast to drive. With this power the boat cruises at 45 MPH getting 1.8 MPG. It is loaded with great options and already has two Garmin 16\" Screens, 8616 XSV's. The Garmin units have the Empire Bus Digital switching on them so you control the whole boat right thru the Garmin screens but there is also a switch panel in the console incase you do not want to turn the Garmin's on. Some of the notable Options include Forward Seating with Removable Forward Facing Backrests, Electric Head, Leaning Post Custom Sport w/ Wrap Around Backrest & Frigid Rigid Ice Chest, Hard Top, Speaker Boxes, and the Powder Coating Package. Any additional Electronics or accessories are available for us to install to your specks weather it be a Trolling Motor, Radar, additional Lighting, or Stereo... We have a big rig shop that specializes in this type of rigging. The Head is mounted on a slider to allow you to keep it out of the way and make more space in the console.

The R317 has an overall length of 31 feet making it not only the largest Robalo afloat, but also the largest dual console Robalo. A perfect blend of versatility for both the die-hard fishing enthusiast and the family minded angler. Sleek lines and loaded with standard features, the R317 is the boat you have been waiting for.

Loaded with almost every option including 

Twin Yamaha White F300USB's with Electric Steering and Controls. Only 210 Hours

Yamaha Helm Master Joystick with Maneuverability 

16\" Garmin 8616 GPS/Fish Finder

Garmin VHF Radio

Electric Head with Overboard Discharge

Ice Blue Sides and Under Hard Top

Retractable Sure Shade

Dual Bow and Cockpit Covers

Black Powder Coating

Blue LED Underwater Lighting

Upgraded JL Stereo System

Stainless Steel Drink Rod Holders

Stainless Steel Side Ladder

Electric Toilet with Overboard Discharge

Livewell

Fresh and Raw Water Washdown

Anchor Windlass

Removable Cockpit Carpet

"GeneralBoatDescription": [ "

This is the all new Chaparral 310 OSX which is the perfect combination of a Runabout, Bow Rider, & Cruiser with a small cabin! It is powered by twin Yamaha 300 HP 4-Strokes & the Helm Master Joystick w/ Full Maneuverability. The boat is beautiful and loaded with electronics including two Simrad 12\" Multi-Function Displays, JL Audio Stereo, and some awesome Blue LED Cockpit Lighting. It also has a ton of nice options such as Air Conditioning, Helm Master Joystick, Bow & Cockpit Cover, Electric Toilet w/ Overboard Discharge, Bow Filler Cushion & Underwater Lights. This boat has a very unique layout that offers a ton of large seating and Lounging areas and gives you a small cabin with A/C so you can sleep over night or get out of the weather for a while. The Hard Top is huge and has a Sky Light built in making it feel very open in the cockpit. The boat also has a ton of storage in it for all kinds of Toys, Coolers, and Life Jackets.

With a fresh design focused on storage and ergonomics, the 310 OSX from Chaparral is the perfect sport boating platform. The feature-laden helm makes the captain's life easy, and the well-appointed cabin and enclosed head make long days comfortable. The standard wetbar has a refrigerator and stainless-steel sink so you can take all your favorite foods and drinks out on the water. Storage is abundant and the Vista-View lounge seat will make you want to lie in the sunshine for hours. With a multitude of luxurious standard features and an array of options to match any preference, the 310 OSX is ready for whatever the boating season brings.

This is one of the only 30 foot boats out there that has three Captains Chairs at the helm. There is very comfortable seating everywhere and still plenty of room to walk around weather you have a bunch of people on the boat or going out fishing for the day. This R300 is powered by the new Yamaha 350 HP 4-Strokes giving this boat tremendous power for coming out of the hole and cruising strong. It also has the Yamaha Helm Master Joystick Control w/ Auto Pilot. The boat has a ton of standard features including a Shower that comes out of the back of the Hard Top! It is set up with Dual Simrad 16\" Displays, VHF Radio, JL Audio Stereo, & Underwater Lighting. It is also equipped with the Lenco Pro Trim Tab System (Auto Trim Tabs). The head area is very large and easy to get into and has an Electric Head w/ Overboard Discharge. Other options include Bow Table w/ Cushion, Sea Deck Helm Mat, Stainless Drink/ Rod Holders, Tackle Storage, Transducer Upgrade to B175M & Polished Stainless Anchor.

Inshore or offshore the NauticStar 265 XTS is a beast of a bay boat and the largest in the Extreme Tournament Series family of boats. It is the culmination of years of innovation and advanced engineering, with a collection of all the latest bells and whistles. It evolved from customer feedback for the ultimate fishing vessel. With its large forward and aft decks, ample rod storage, 43 gallon bow fish box, 3 livewell/baitwells, 35 Qt YETI cooler, and plenty of tackle storage, the 265 is an amazing fishing platform. Not only is it ergonomically correct and down right comfortable, the newly designed leaning post features Llebroc seating with flip-up bolsters and armrests; a 21 gallon baitwell with transparent lid; lighted push button switch panel; and conveniently located freshwater washdown.

This 2024 Chaparral 270 OSX Bow Rider is beautiful! It is powered with a Yamaha Four Stroke F300XSB2 300 HP with Digital Electric Steering. It has some awesome features such as a comfortable rear seat that transforms into a very large lounge and an Electric Folding Arch. It has an awesome electronics set up including Dual Simrad 9\" GPS / Fish Finders & JL Audio Stereo. There is very comfortable Sea Deck Flooring that snaps in which really feels great on your feet. Other options include Ice Blue Hull Sides, White Bottom, Painted Black Hull Stripe, EFX Electric Folding Arch Tower with Bimini, Bow and Cockpit Cover, Premium Package, Upgraded Seats, Docking Lights, Bow Scuff Plate, Transom Stereo Remote, Fender Holders, Air Pump, JL Upgraded Stereo System, Electric Head, Cockpit Table with Teak Inlay, Snap in Seadek Flooring, Anchor Windlass with 250' rope, Polished Stainless Steel Anchor, Dual Batteries with Charger, 5 Year Component Warranty, Twin Simrad GPS/Fish Finders, and Deluxe Steering Whee.

The open-concept design carries forward into the bow area which features hinged storage beneath luxuriously appointed upholstery. Chaparral went to great lengths to create a powerful and agile craft that glides through the water with minimal noise.

This boat is very affordable and super easy to maintain and go have fun in. The layout is perfect for cruising comfortably around the bay and near shore with up to 10 people. The cockpit in floor storage hatch was designed to fit a Wake Board in it and it has 30 quart cooler under the back seat. The boat also has a rea sun lounge with storage under it. This boat is very easy to go out and use for the day and then bring back home, clean it, and put it away with very minimal work. One person can load and unload this boat at the boat ramp and handle everything very easily.

This is a brand new 2024 Sportsman Open 212 Center Console Powered by a Yamaha 150 HP 4-Stroke. It is has a ton of incredible Standard Features such as the new Sea Keeper Ride Auto Trim Tab System. The Garmin also displays all the Engine Data. You also control all the switching on the boat thru the Garmin and it also has nice switches on the dash. The hull Sides are Ice Blue and it has the Ice Blue under the Hard Top. The Fusion Stereo is also Standard and comes with 6 speakers. This boat has some great options on it as well including the Under Leaning Post Tackle Storage, Garmin VHF Radio, & Porta Pottie.

There is a nice Porcelain Toilet in the console w/ Overboard Discharge. The boat comes with a ton of Standard Features including the Sea Keeper Ride Auto Trim Tab System, Hydraulic Jack Plate and Underwater Lighting. This layout gives you a tremendous amount of space and it feels very open. This boat will quickly become your ultimate fishing and cruising machine. The deck is designed for all the way around fishability but still retaining a forward and aft casting deck. At the transom, two iconic aquarium livewells with a deep center seat. Opening the seat reveals great access to the bilge and other important components. Two comfortable large seats at the helm covered by a beautiful fiberglass hard-top packed with amenities. Up front, an extended chaise lounge with a massive fish box below, an additional livewell, anchor compartment and additional storage. This versatile boat will quickly adapt to your current activity from hard-core fishing to a great comfortable cruiser.

Trailer Included! This is an incredible 266 Cayman Sky Deck Bay Boat! It is powered by a Yamaha 450 HP V8! This boat is already Full Optioned out to the max with Electronics and Accessories including Two Simrad 12\" Screens & a 9\" in the Sky Deck, Minn Kota Trolling Motor, Power Pole, VHF Radio & JL Audio Stereo Upgrade. It also has Simrad SS175M Transducer, Underwater Lights, Sea Deck Helm Mat, Toilet w/ Overboard Discharge, Bow Table, Bow Filler Cushion, Stainless Rod/ Drink Holders, Leaning Post w/ Reversible Backrest & Arm Rest, & Custom Anchor. The boat comes with the Trailer! It has been designed from the ground up to help you catch fish. The bow features an elevated casting deck that smoothly transitions to the wide gunnels that run around the boat. Cushioned seats and an enclosed head help keep you comfortable on all-day trips. The second station, from where the SkyDeck gets its name, gives you an unbeatable vantage point that is great for both navigation and fishing. Rod holders and storage compartments have been built into every surface of this boat so you can use all of your deck space for fishing. From offshore to narrow creeks, this bay boat will keep you in the middle of the action.

This Nor-Tech 450 Sport Center Console is here at the dealership right now and it is absolutely beautiful! The boat has a Sea Keeper 6 Gyro Stabilizer in it and is powered by Quad 500 HP Mercury Racing Engines. The boat has two Garmin 9622's flush mounted in the dash, Auto Pilot, FLIR Night Vision, Radar, VHF Radio, XM Weather & Radio, and 1KW Transducer. It has the Upgraded Premium Stereo System and the Sure Shade - Power Retractable. The cabin is Air Conditioned and has an enclosed Head & Shower. It has large windows that give you a very open feel inside. The seating in the rear of the boat is very large and comfortable. There is a Northern Lights Generator - Diesel, which is in an easily accessible compartment under the rear seat. The bow has the Electric Table and a Bow Thruster. There is Sea Deck flooring throughout the boat. Custom Painted Graphics, Paint console, Helm Seat, & Interior walls. The engines are hooked up to a Reverso Flush System making it very easy to flush the engines. Other options include, Bar w/ Cold Plate, Marine Guardian Security System, Black Oak LED Light Bar, & Underwater Lights color changing.

Custom-built for the fisherman in mind, the 392 Superfish is a composite construction of fiberglass and Kevlar, making this one heavy, stable, and tough boat. The Superfish is a little wider at the waterline than most boats of her size and the fuel tanks are at the centerline, making for a very stable ride. Enjoy ample storage for tackle and bait, as well as a custom built-in fish station and tuna tubes. The entire single-level cockpit is self-draining via and under-deck plumbing system glassed into the cockpit liner. Serious anglers will appreciate the efforts Nor-Tech took to create the finest sea chest pump system ever developed on a fishing boat. At the transom, there are two 65 gallon live wells and built-in tuna tubes. Rod holders are located throughout the boat, from bow to stern. A removeable tower encourage you to reel in the biggest catch possible. The 392 Superfish has one of the most comfortable pilot and co-pilot seats, inspired by seats found in race cars for ultimate comfort and security. From the pilot seat, you’ll feel cared for with navigation screens and an ergonomically designed steering column. Fishing just got even more super.

"GeneralBoatDescription": [ "

This is a beautiful Robalo R270 Center Console powered by twin Yamaha 250 HP 4-Strokes with Digital Electric Steering and Digital Throttle & Shift. This boat is absolutely loaded with incredible Electronics, Features & Options. It has two Simrad 9\" Multi-Function Displays flush mounted in the dash. It has a awesome JL Audio Stereo with (6) Speakers and a 10\" Sub. It also has a VHF Radio, Simrad SS175M Transducer, NMEA 200 Pkg for Engine data on Simrad Screens, & Underwater Lights. The boat has a very nice Side Entry Door w/ Ladder which makes it very easy boarding the boat from a dock or boat lift and getting out of the water. The rear cockpit feels very large & open and has an awesome fold down transom seat and a Wetbar / Bait Prep Station w/ a sliding cooler under it. Anchoring is nice and easy with the Windlass in the bow which also has a beautiful Polished Stainless Anchor.  


The R270 gives you a smooth and sturdy ride while remaining responsive. Quick plane times and our Hydro Lift TM Multi-Angle Hull will deliver you consistent performance that will thrill you every time you take it out. The large door on the front of the console gives you an easy way to the head where you can access the standard porcelain toilet. This 2015 Edgewater 320CC is in excellent condition and comes with the 2018 Amera Trail Trailer. This Trailer has Electric Over Hydraulic Brakes and the Bunks were replaced in 2025. The boat is kept in a high and dry and gets cleaned regularly, all the cushions are stored in the console so they are in excellent condition. There is a very nice Electric Head in the Console with Overboard Discharge. It has an awesome electronics package including twin Garmin 7416XSV Multi-Function Displays, Auto Pilot, Radar 24\" XHD Dome, VHF Radio, JL Audio Stereo, and Battery Charger w/ Shore Power Connection. It is also equipped with some very nice accessories such as the Rhodan Trolling Motor w/ a New 2025 Lithium Battery (Abyss). This is a 96\" Shaft. TACO Outriggers w/ Telescoping Poles & Anchor Windlass. The boat has an awesome windshield that is built in to the Console, hard Top & Frame giving you excellent protection and incredible visibility. If you are looking for a boat like this you must come and see this one! 

Where weight is critical for superior hull performance and fuel economy in a power boat, EdgeWater is proud to introduce the exciting 320CC. Built using Single-Piece Infusion, or SPI, enabled us to create a lighter, more efficient, more environmentally sensitive power boat. Outfitted with the “ClearView” custom engineered windshield, the 320CC allows for improved visibility whether heading offshore or to your favorite getaway.

Introducing the all-new Heritage 321 — the ultimate family center console and the new flagship of the Heritage Series. Built on the proven running surface of the Open 322, this next-generation 32-foot model delivers the perfect balance of family-friendly comfort, versatile design and offshore capability. From sandbar days to sunset cruises, the spacious layout was reimagined to bring everyone along for the ride. Lounge up front on the electric actuated bow table that converts to a sun deck, relax in the new mezzanine-style rear-facing seat, or gather around the aft cockpit table while the kids swim using the dual side entry doors with full 180° swing. Thoughtful details are everywhere — from the massive 275-quart built-in console cooler and under gunwale storage boxes to the integrated trash bins and freshwater sandbar shower. And with premium technology like Garmin electronics, Seakeeper Ride for unmatched stability and available Seakeeper Gyro, the Heritage 321 is ready for anything a family can throw at it — making every day on the water more comfortable, more versatile and more unforgettable.

2016 Sportsman 232 Open center console powered by a Yamaha F250 XA motor with only 185 hours of use. Clean boat with Coastal Beige hull color and matching beige upholstery. SIMRAD GPS/fish finder, Bluetooth stereo with cockpit speakers, freshwater shower, and much more. This is a roomy boat with lots of comfortable seating in the bow and stern. Excellent fishing features including a live well, rod holders, and tackle storage. If you are looking for a mid-sized center console that is great for the family and still fishes with the big boys, this is the boat for you. Trailer not included. A trailer can be added for an additional cost.




Sportsman Boat’s Open Series ranges from 21’ to 31’. With much of the same outstanding design and comfort features of it’s sister ship, the Heritage Series, the Open Series is designed for the more serious angler, but lacks nothing for the family outing.

This 2020 Chaparral 280 OSX is in excellent condition and has just had an entire set of new Factory Upholstery installed and brand new Gator step Flooring installed. This interior is in like new condition. It has incredible power with the twin Yamaha 250 HP 4-Strokes. There are only 169 hours on the boat. The Helm seating is extremely comfortable and offers a very commanding feel for the Captain with a very unobstructed view and great positioning. The Helm seat swivels to the side of the boat to create a great seating arrangement when you are not underway. This is a one owner boat. It is loaded with the following options, Fiberglass Hard Top, Bow & Cockpit Cover, Premium Pkg. JL Audio Stereo Upgrade, Optimus Joystick Piloting w/ Sea Station, Dual Garmin 742 XSV Screens, Trim Tabs w/ Indicators, Electric Toilet w/ Overboard Discharge, Polished Stainless Anchor, Flag Pole, Side Entry Ladder, Stainless Rod Holders, Blue Underwater Lights, & Windlass Pkg.  Trailer in photos not included.

Step aboard and you will find an expertly-crafted second station that gives you more control than ever before, extending your vantage point and taking your angling adventure to new heights--literally. The 246 builds upon the tradition of Robalo's go-anywhere Caymans, a family of bay boats that are just as comfortable on offshore adventures as they are at shallow nooks and crannies by the coast. Ample deck space gives you room to welcome the whole crew on board, a perk that the addition of the Sky Deck only amplifies. Built-in storage for everything from rods to live bait to tackle is abundant, so you're never limited by the capacity of your ride. That convenience extends up to the second station, where stainless-steel drink holders make it easy for you to kick back and stay perched there however long you like.

This 262 Sportsman is just an awesome boat all the way around! From the looks to the functionality this boat has it all! It is Powered by twin Yamaha 200 HP 4-Strokes with the new Digital Electric Steering, (F200XSA2). It is a very open boat with plenty of space in the rear cockpit as well as in the bow area. It is loaded with options and features including the new Sea Keeper Auto Trim Tab System, Double Side Dive Doors, Two Garmin 1243XSV Multi-Function Displays and Auto Pilot. Other Electronics  include the JL Audio Speakers, Battery Charger & Garmin VHF Radio. This new model has a very unique Layout with Double Side Dive Doors and Double Aquarium Live wells with a nice Fold Down Bench Seat in the Transom. There is beautiful seating and lounging space in the bow area which has Forward Facing Backrests. Other Features include the Windlass for the Anchor, Electric Toilet, Underwater Lights (Blue LED), Tackle Storage and Freshwater Shower.

 

 

Climbing on-board the Open 262, you are met with amenities you've never seen on a 26 foot boat. Starting with the dual side entry doors which open 180-degrees for unobstructed water-centric access. For shade, a feature-packed fiberglass hard-top with lights, speakers and rod holders. At the helm, state-of-the-art standard electronics and protection all the way around thanks to the integrated tempered glass windshield. Gorgeous twin aquarium livewells at the transom accompany the fishing-ready cockpit layout. And let's not forget, a modern finely-tuned hull with superior ride designed for the latest engines.

This Sportsman 247 OE is a super clean looking boat and it is powered with a Yamaha 300 HP 4-Stoke w/ Digital Throttle & Shift and Digital Electric Steering & Mounted on a Hydraulic Jack Plate! The new Sea keeper Ride Auto Trim Tab System comes Standard on the boat. This is an Automatic Trim Tab System that keeps the boat level while underway. There are a ton of other Standard Features including the Garmin 12\" Display (1242 XSV), VHF Radio, JL Audio Stereo w/ 8 Speakers, & Underwater Lighting. It is also loaded with Options including the Garmin Force Kraken Trolling Motor 75\" w/ Charger, On-Board Battery Charger, Under Leaning Post Tackle Storage, and Porta-Pottie. This is a very unique design which gives you a tremendous amount of space walking around in this boat as well as offering incredible seating and fishability. The two Aquarium Style Live wells in the rear cockpit are nice a large and easy to access and the rear Seat easily flips up to sit or folds down to finish the casting platform. There is also huge access to all the equipment in the bilge under the rear seat making it very easy to work on any pumps or other equipment in there. The Forward Lounge is very comfortable and you feel very secure riding there. It is insulated to be used as a cooler or storage. 


The Masters 247OE comes in sporting a design following suit with the Sportsman design language. The extended console brings you a very comfortable chaise lounge and a large storage compartment. The deck features dual aquarium livewells, an open bow design with a step up casting deck which includes a livewell, best-in-class bilge access and much more. This is all paired up to a very capable hull designed for shallow water and a smooth ride.

This Sportsman 232 Center Console is a show stopper! Powered by the Yamaha 300 4-Stroke w/ Digital Throttle & Shift as well as the Electric Power steering it is as Powerful as it is luxurious. These advanced features make this boat feel super smooth to operate and easy to drive. It is also equipped with the Sea Keeper Auto Trim Tab System which automatically keeps the boat stable while running. The boat looks Stunning with the Storm Cloud Grey Hull sides & Bottom matched w/ the Black Powder Coating and Black Under the Hard Top. It comes Standard with the 12\" Garmin Multi-Function Display, VHF Radio, and Stereo w/ 8 JL Audio Speakers. The boat is loaded with nice options including the Premium Dual Chair Leaning Post w/ Flip Up Bolsters, Under Leaning Post Tackle Storage,  On-Board Battery Charger, Porcelain Head w/ Overboard Discharge, & Anchor Windlass.


Designed to be the ultimate family fishing boat in the 23-foot class, the Open 232 brings you fit, finish and features not seen in this category of boat. The fishing amenities check every box for a day offshore fishing including ample rod storage, Gemlux rod holders, a large, insulated aquarium livewell and more. Then when it’s time for the family to jump on-board you’re greeted with safe comfortable seating, insulated coolers and storage to multiple anchors to make sandbar trips a breeze. And the best part? All of these features are wrapped up in an easy to trailer 23 foot center console that will bring years of memorable trips for you and the family.

"GeneralBoatDescription": [ "

This is the brand new model from Robalo, The R257 Dual Console! This boat has amazing power with the Twin Yamaha 200 HP 4-Strokes. These engines have the Digital Throttle & Shift as well as the new Electro Hydraulic Steering. The boat is loaded with Electronics including a Simrad 12\" Display, VHF Radio, & JL Audio Stereo System. It has a huge list of options that are on this boat including the Anchor Windlass, Electric Toilet / Overboard Discharge, Forward Fly Shade, Bow Table, Bow Filler, Bow & Cockpit Covers, Stainless Drink / Rod Holders, & the Lenco Pro Trim Tab System. This is a Auto Trim Tab System that automatically keeps the boat level while under way. This new model has a very nice and functional layout offering a ton of comfortable seating and lounging areas. It comes Standard with a Side Entry Door making it very easy for boarding. The access to everything in the Bilge is very easy to get to thru a massive transom door that lifts up making the whole bilge wide open for access to pumps and everything in there. There is a ton of space in the cockpit, it feels like this boat would be great for entertaining 10 people in.

With no shortage of comfortable seating from bow to stern and plenty of deep storage compartments, the R257 makes those long days exploring on the water carefree and enjoyable. Fishermen will love the twin 50-gallon fish boxes, the 30-gallon aft livewell, and all of the rod holders throughout. Passengers will be sure to appreciate the standard oversized hardtop featuring a new stylish, D-shaped frame engineered to reduce clutter and visionary obstructions for the captain. SEA KEEPER 2 Gyro Stabilizer Included!!  TRAILER Included!! This Contender 32 ST is absolutely beautiful and has amazing power with the Mercury 400 HP Verados! These engines only have 372 hours and Mercury Warranty on them till 7/1/2026! This is a single owner boat & was custom ordered with the Sea Keeper 2 Gyro which was installed at the Contender Factory under the rear deck for incredible performance and reduces the roll by about 95%. This drastically reduces sea sickness and fatigue while out on the open water making you and your crew much more comfortable throughout the day. The boat has been kept on a lift with a roof over it and a full boat cover on it it's whole life. It is loaded with Electronics & Equipment including Dual Garmin 16\" Screens (8616 XSV's), Open Array Radar - Fantom, Minn Kota Trolling Motor, LED Light Bar, & VHF Radio. The Amera Trailer is in great shape and was very rarely used. This boat is a must see. Please contact us for more info. Sea Trials available. 

The 32ST is a fishing machine. Built for kite fishing in Miami, the 32ST embodies “Performance Through Innovation”. Years of improvements and custom boat building has created a 32 that is unsurpassed for performance and “fish-ability”. The attention to detail allows you to custom build a boat that fits your needs, whether it’s a blustery day offshore, or a lake calm day at the sandbar. Powered by twin Yamaha 400 HP engines, the Contender 32′ ST is an open water speed demon. With a standard 310-gallon fuel tank capacity, you’re boundaries won’t be limited by range.

"GeneralBoatDescription": [ "

This 262 Sportsman is just an awesome boat all the way around! From the looks to the functionality this boat has it all! It is Powered by twin Yamaha 200 HP 4-Strokes with the new Digital Electric Steering, (F200XSA2). It is a very open boat with plenty of space in the rear cockpit as well as in the bow area. It is loaded with options and features including the new Sea Keeper Auto Trim Tab System, Double Side Dive Doors, Two Garmin 1243XSV Multi-Function Displays and Auto Pilot. Other Electronics  include the JL Audio Speakers, Battery Charger & Garmin VHF Radio. This new model has a very unique Layout with Double Side Dive Doors and Double Aquarium Live wells with a nice Fold Down Bench Seat in the Transom. There is beautiful seating and lounging space in the bow area which has Forward Facing Backrests. Other Features include the Windlass for the Anchor, Electric Toilet, Underwater Lights (Blue LED), Tackle Storage and Freshwater Shower.

 

 

Climbing on-board the Open 262, you are met with amenities you've never seen on a 26 foot boat. Starting with the dual side entry doors which open 180-degrees for unobstructed water-centric access. For shade, a feature-packed fiberglass hard-top with lights, speakers and rod holders. At the helm, state-of-the-art standard electronics and protection all the way around thanks to the integrated tempered glass windshield. Gorgeous twin aquarium livewells at the transom accompany the fishing-ready cockpit layout. And let's not forget, a modern finely-tuned hull with superior ride designed for the latest engines.

This 2025 Concept 27 Center Console is absolutely amazing! This is a Dealer Demo Boat. From the Electric Blue Painted Graphics to the Hi-Performance Ride this boat is a true Adrenaline Rush! It is powered by a Mercury Racing 400 HP V10 with only about 30 hours on it. It has a Full Boat Cover that covers all the way down the Hull Sides. It is set up with the best electronics package you can get including two Garmin 12\" 8612 XSV Units with the Garmin Empire Bus Digital Switching System integrated into them. This gives you all your switching controls for the boat such as all the Lighting & Pumps right on the Garmin screens keeping the Console looking very clean. There is also a Rubber Switch Panel just inside the Side Console Door so you can turn things on without your Garmins being turned on. The Hull Sides, Console and Top Deck are Painted with an incredible Blue paint. The List of other Options includes, Fiberglass Hard Top, Painted Hard Top, LED Underwater Lights (2) Blue, Painted Mohawk on Engine, VHF Radio, Battery Charger, JL Audio Stereo, Sliding Ice Chest, Leaning Post Storage Box, Freshwater Shower, Transducer, Stainless Steel Rub Rail, Live well in Transom, Fiberglass Side Netting Storage, Forward Bow Seating Backrests, Black Gel Hull Bottom, Garmin Empire Digital Switching, Smart Craft Connect, Black Oak Razor Light Bar, Painted Console, Marine Flooring (Dektek), Full Mooring Cover to chine. It does not have a trailer but we can get one made for it.


The performance of the 27 Open Deck Series must be experienced to be believed. Powered by a Mercury Racing 400 HP V10, its lightweight hull is dually suited for performance boating with family and friends or the occasional offshore fishing excursion. Superior handling, maximum performance and a low cost of ownership makes for ear-to-ear grins every time you’re out on the water. Stylishly appointed and rigged to perfection, the 27 is a solid choice for a best-all-around adventure machine.

This 2020 Robalo R302 Center Console is in extremely nice condition. Ii looks almost new. It is Powered by twin Yamaha 300 HP 4-Strokes with Digital Throttle & Shift. There are about 550 hours on the Engines. The boat is loaded with very nice Features & Options Including a Side Dive Door, Two Garmin 12\" Screens, VHF Radio, Stereo w/ JL Audio Speakers, Bow Table w/ Filler Cushion, and Dual Live Wells. The layout is amazing and features the Rear Facing Mezzanine Seat w/ a Live well in it and a very large Rear Fold Down Seat. The bow is super comfortable with wrap around seating and Forward Facing Backrests built in. These also have storage and a Trash Can in them. The 302 Robalo is a very large 30 footer. It has a 10'6\" beam and a lot of free board giving it a very safe and Dry Ride. The console is also very spacious inside and at the same time easy to see over while sitting at the helm. This is a very unique design and once you feel it out for yourself you will be amazed at how comfortable and ergonomic it is. The hard top is extremely large and has rear stations adding extra support. The windshield gives you great protection and eliminates the need for eisenglass. The boat is rigged with a pair of 300 HP Yamaha 4-Strokes.  Please see the full list of options below.

Twin Yamaha F300XCA's

(2) Garmin 8612 XSV displays

Call Erickson Marine today!  


The Open 252 Center Console boasts the latest Sportsman design and cutting-edge electronics with the perfect combination of family-friendly features, cruising comfort and offshore fishing capabilities - all in one easy-to-trailer 25-foot package. Whether you're a seasoned angler or a family seeking adventure on the water, the Sportsman Open 252 is designed to meet all your boating needs. With a sleek and stylish design, this center console delivers exceptional performance and handling, making it the ultimate choice for any boating enthusiast. Experience the best of both worlds with the Sportsman Open 252 Center Console - the ultimate blend of versatility, functionality, and style.

This Chaparral 270 OSX Bowrider is the perfect combination of Luxury and Performance! The boat has incredible power with the Yamaha 350 HP 4-Stoke engine and it is loaded with awesome seating and lounging areas. The Rear seating is the stand out area how it converts from a double sided bench seat into a nice reclining Lounge. The Bimini coming off the Electric Folding Arch Tower has a big extension built into so you get a tremendous amount of shade when you want to or it can removed if you prefer more sun. The boat is also set up with two beautiful Simrad Multi-Function Displays. These Simrad units do everything including Navigation, Depth reading and displaying your engine data. The boat has the Upgraded Stereo System with JL Audio Speakers which are the best speakers in the industry. It also has an Electric Toilet in the boat as well as a Cockpit Table, Anchor Windlass, & Dual Battery Charger. Other options include, Premium Package, Air Pump, Bow & Cockpit Cover, Polish Stainless Anchor, & Metallic Black Painted Boot Stripe.

Chaparral is re-writing the rules on outboard boating. The 270 OSX is a trendsetter in design, performance, and function. The helm features a glass dash with dual touch screen Simrad displays. The cockpit is open, and spacious and features a multi-position sun lounger aft. The open-concept design carries forward into the bow area which features hinged storage beneath luxuriously appointed upholstery. Chaparral went to great lengths to create a powerful and agile craft that will provide a smooth ride in any kind of water. The 270 OSX was designed with the most advanced technology afloat today. Our Standard Dual 7\" inch Simrad touchscreen displays with controls are NMEA compatible and offer navigation, engine management, full gauge compliment, and can be customized to your personal preferences.

The Open 282 is designed for those looking to have a great all around boat that is big enough to entertain and go offshore but with all of the creature comforts packed in. For those that like speed, a pair of Yamaha 300HP outboards is sure to make her go.

This Sportsman 352 Open is in stock right now and powered with the new Triple Mercury 400 HP V10 4-Strokes w/ Joystick Piloting!! This boat performs incredibly well with these engines. Sportsman did an awesome job in the design of this boat. There is so much to offer including the Air Conditioned cabin in the console, Mercury Joystick Steering w/ Sea Station, two Garmin 22\" Multi Function Displays, Open Array Radar, & a wide array of seating & Lounging space. The boat also features two side Dive Doors, two 30 gallon Live wells, & (2) Electric Reel Outlets. The Cabin is Airconditioned and powered by a 12 volt battery operated system and there are also vents on the dash for the drivers. The stereo is all JL Audio and has (10) Speakers, (2) Subs, and (3) Amps. The access into the bilge compartment is gigantic, all the equipment in the bilge is extremely easy to get to and there is a lot of storage in there. The seating is amazing and offers Club style fold down benches in the rear cockpit. There is also very comfortable seating in the bow with an Electric Table / Filler Lounge allowing you to sit up there and have lunch with the table up or lower it down to use as a big sun lounge or lower it all the way down to make it completely open.

Better than new! 2024 Chaparral 270 OSX powered by a Yamaha F300XSB2 (32 hours) with Digital Electric Steering for the ultimate in easy control with warranty until 1-6-29. The hull sides are a sharp steel blue gel coat color with a black bottom. The EFX arch tower folds down with the flip of a switch. Options include an electric head with overboard discharge, cockpit table with dedicated storage, Sea deck swim platform, anchor windlass, stainless steel anchor, dual LED underwater lights and a long list of quality standard features. No trailer but one can be provided at an additional cost. 

Additions that make this boat special:

  • Back-to-Back Aft Seating Converts to Oversized Sun Lounge
  • Bow Canvas Sky Shade
  • Brand new PowerPole (never used)  
  • Two rod holders added to the rear gunnels
  • Custom height adjustments added to both captain chairs
  • Full canvas cover – cockpit and bow

This 2024 Chaparral 270 OSX is essentially brand new. The engine has only 32 hours on it. The owners are moving and can’t take the boat with them. What a great opportunity for someone to get into a nearly brand-new boat *with upgrades* for far less than the cost of a new boat.

 

Call Erickson Marine today!  


Chaparral is re-writing the rules on outboard boating. The 270 OSX is a trendsetter in design, performance, and function. The helm features a glass dash with dual touch screen Simrad displays. The cockpit is open, and spacious and features a multi-position sun lounger aft. The open-concept design carries forward into the bow area which features hinged storage beneath luxuriously appointed upholstery. Chaparral went to great lengths to create a powerful and agile craft that glides through the water with minimal noise.

If you are looking for the Ultimate Fishing Boat for inshore and near shore then look no further than this Andros Tarpon 26! This boat only drafts 10\" of water perfect for fishing in the bays and flats but it also has a big bow and deep freeboard making you feel very comfortable going offshore as well. This boat was kept in a High and Dry since new and it shows like a brand new boat. The owner kept it perfect. The boat is powered by a Mercury 300 HP 4-Stroke V8 with only 208 hours on it. The engine has Mercury Gold Warranty on it till 5/18/2029!!! The Tower is incredible! It is very easy to get into it and it has amazing visibility up there for sighting fish or just enjoying the view. There is a complete set of Electronics and Controls up there. The boat has so many features and Accessories including Two Power Pole 10' Blades, Porta Jack, Minn Kota Trolling Motor, Radar, Stereo, Garmin 12\" Screen, VHF Radio, Bow Cushion Set w/ Removable Backrests, & Light Bar. The Trolling Motor batteries are set up with the Stealth Battery Charger so the batteries are being charged while the engine is running so you barely ever have to plug in the charger to charge the Trolling Motor Batteries. You have to see this boat in person to get a feel for how much room it has in it. It's Huge!

The Andros Tarpon 26 is special design that allows for a wide variety of fishing / family boating adventures. It's right at home 30 miles offshore when the weather picks up and on the flats in the shallowest of waters. She’s large enough to bring friends, family and lots of gear offshore but small and nimble enough to fit into tight inshore areas. The Tarpon 26 boasts a high bow with sharp entry making for a soft and very dry ride. The 11 degree deadrise at the transom along with the weight being centered and balanced perfectly the ability to float extremely skinny for a boat this size.  

 

The Tarpon 26 is packed full of features, storage and clever design ideas to make the perfect family adventure machine.

This boat is in nice condition and is loaded with Equipment & Accessories including the Half Tower, Simrad 12\" EVO 2 Display, Simrad 7\" Display in Tower, Radar, VHF Radio, Stereo, Atlas Jack Plate, Power Pole 10' Blade, Outriggers, Forward Bimini Top, & Underwater Lights. The boat is wired for a Trolling Motor. The Power Pole was recently rebuilt with new Hydraulic Lines and Hardware.


In keeping with Contender’s tradition of hard-core fishing boats, the 25 Bay offers all of the amenities you would expect in a larger bay boat, while incorporating some previously unseen features to accommodate the whole family, too.  The large casting platforms – forward and aft – provide ample room for several fishermen without ever feeling crowded.  The use of covering boards and bolster pads along the full length of the cockpit mean that you will never beat up your knees while fighting a fish from inside the boat.

If you are looking for a boat that can do just about everything from Cruising with Friends and Family to Fishing in the Bay or Near Shore to Hanging out at the Sandbars or pulling the kids around on a tube this is the perfect boat for you! This NauticStar 231 Hybrid Center Console does it all and has incredible power with the Yamaha 250 HP VMAX SHO! This engine only has about 200 hours on it. The boat is set up with a ton of equipment including Two Power Poles, Simrad GPS / Fish Finder, VHF Radio, Stereo and Ski Pole. The boat is full of seating especially up in the bow. All the cushions are in great shape and are very comfortable. It is very wide in the bow which makes it very roomy for laying out or setting up the Table to have a nice lunch. The rear cockpit is also very functional and offers a great casting platform or Seating all the way across the boat. This is one of the most versatile boats out there. Come check it out!

If you need a serious fishing machine for yourself or a boat with enough room for a large crowd, the 231 Hybrid is the boat featuring the STAR Performance System. Seating for 10, 2-aerated live wells, 2-insulated fish boxes, 2-onboard coolers and a center console with head compartment are just a few of the fishing and comfort features that the 231 Hybrid offers. Performance, comfort and versatility describe this amazing craft. Turn your 231 into a versatile Sport Deck by adding the sport package option which includes a swim platform, Bimini top, and Infinity stereo system.

This brand new 2026 Contender 28 T Center Console does it all! It is powered by twin Yamaha 300 HP 4-Strokes w/ Digital Throttle & Shift & Digital Electric Steering. This model is the newly designed deck with sleeker deck lines. It is gorgeous! The 28 T is a hard core fishing machine that can be used for just about anything. It is now Standard with the Sea Keeper RIDE Auto Trim Tab System which automatically keeps the boat stabile while underway. The boat is loaded with nice seating for everyone. It has some very nice features including the upgraded console with Electronics Box w/ Sliding Door & Garmin Electronics including two Garmin 8612XSV's & a JL Audio Stereo System. The Garmin screens also have all the switching for the boat built into them and it has a switch panel as well for redundancy. The boat has the Hard Top with LED lighting & Electric Toilet. The list of other options includes, Transducer Install, Additional Battery w/ switch, Electric head w/ Y-valve, Custom Leaning Post w/ Wrap Around Backrest & Frigid Rigid Cooler, Powder Coating Pkg., Finger Grip Handrails on T-Top, King fish rod holders, Live well light, Live well clear lid, Gemlux flush mount scoops, Fresh water, Garelick boarding ladder, Pop-up stern cleats, Raw water wash down, Steering wheel - stainless w/ knob, Forward bow seating - Bench Style, Backrests - Forward Facing for Bow Seating, Cockpit coaming bolsters, Upholstery Bentley Stitching, Under gunnel rod racks, Rub Rail - Stainless Steel Insert.

 


The Contender 28T is hand built in Homestead, FL. The 28′ boat is a center console classic. Built for speed, and built to last, the hull goes to sea with a ride like no other. Every Contender is built to order. Built with the options you want to make your boat. Every Contender is hand laid fiberglass with an attention to detail in hull ride that keeps captains and customers coming back with new developments to further their boating game. The build process is not an automated assembly line that offers no options. Our model options make ever boat unique with the personality and style to make it your own. Built for speed, range, and finding big fish in blue water. The 28T is the ride designed to take you beyond the jetty, and into the deep blue ocean in pursuit of ocean pelagics that most only see in posters.
